name: glassbridge
description: Desktop-first Android device access and live control framework

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --workspace apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.validate:staged: npm run secrets:staged && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:frontend && npm run desktop:check
scripts.validate:release: npm run secrets:repo && npm run secrets:history && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:desktop
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:device: npm run build && npm run test:backend && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run desktop:check && npm run desktop:build
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && npm run test:frontend
